errors.quote: For $0\le i<f-1$ (top position set aside) ... so this implements $T_0$ everywhere.
errors.problem: The top selected position j_{f-1} is set aside and never handled again, so the procedure as written does not perform y_{j_{f-1}}\gets y_{j_{f-1}}\oplus x_{j_{f-1}}, and for f=1 it does nothing. The paper finishes with a two-bit XOR on x_{j_{f-1}}, y_{j_{f-1}} via the elementary-stream lemma in O(V), and it defines T_0 as the XORs at j_0,...,j_{f-2} only. The page's "the XOR permutation T_0" leaves that scope unstated.

errors.quote: Since $T_0$ and $S_0$ are bijections agreeing off $\mathcal B,$ $T_0S_0^{-1}$ fixes $\mathcal B^c$ and permutes $\mathcal B,$
errors.problem: Bijections that agree off \mathcal B only give that T_0S_0^{-1} fixes S_0(\mathcal B^c) pointwise. Concluding that it fixes \mathcal B^c needs T_0(\mathcal B)=\mathcal B, which the paper derives from T_0 preserving all guard values, hence S_0(\mathcal B^c)=T_0(\mathcal B^c)=\mathcal B^c.
